name: Starlay Finance (Acala) empty USDC reserve liquidity-index inflation
summary: Starlay's Aave-v2-derived LendingPool on Acala EVM+ adds each flash-loan premium to the reserve liquidityIndex divided by the lToken totalSupply, with no minimum supply, and LTokenRev2.burn converts withdrawals to scaled units with half-up rayDiv. On the nearly empty lUSDC reserve (scaled supply 1) the attacker looped 200 USDC flash loans to raise the index from 1.0000016e27 to 1.35e36, recovered its USDC through deposit/withdraw rounding, and borrowed the pool's DOT and LDOT against the overvalued one-unit lUSDC collateral.

loss.notes: Exact net pool depletion across the attacker EOA's 50 successful pool-touching transactions (source-9), blocks 5500951..5502396: lDOT reserve 0x2a43c0d689fdbde50a78c36ab8067cc890c9fb5e lost 1078770644033000 DOT base units (10 decimals) and lLDOT reserve 0xb58cb2e345e9ff3484aeace7595ff2334328c6b1 lost 14373778782257000 LDOT base units (10 decimals). Per-transaction netting removes attacker-supplied USDC (donations, flash-loan premiums and deposits all returned to the attacker through withdrawal rounding). The lUSDC reserve additionally lost 3876 USDC base units (0.003876 USDC, repaid by an unrelated borrower in 0x5ae63d35) in 0xf594d5a4; it is omitted as immaterial. Pool balances fell from 116542.8723585865 DOT / 1431951.1855841918 LDOT at block 5500950 to 0.2825116515 DOT / 0.6255858231 LDOT at block 5502396; the remainder of that fall is withdrawals by unrelated depositors. Valued at DefiLlama quotes at the anchor time; the protocol's own oracle 0x93344c0d187a44a1cd212d3da59a5c13a31e6428 read 6.9192 USD/DOT and 0.980189 USD/LDOT at block 5500950. The total agrees with the publicly reported ~2.1m USD loss (source-13). No recovery is netted.

ageReset.description: LendingPoolConfigurator.initReserve created the lUSDC InitializableImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy and initialized it with LTokenRev2 0x073d27dc27ed45a671182a52b1555d3bca7a1be4 in this transaction (initialize sets the EIP-1967 slot without an Upgraded event). The slot and runtime are unchanged through block 5500950 and no Upgraded event exists.

limitations: Acala's eth-rpc-adapter (https://eth-rpc-acala.aca-api.network, rpc_methods lists no debug_* method) cannot trace the exploit, so the verifier's execution-trace check for the lUSDC proxy -> LTokenRev2 DELEGATECALL is INCONCLUSIVE; execution is evidenced only by the 59 Transfer, 30 Mint and 29 Burn logs emitted by the proxy in source-1 and by the EIP-1967 slot value at block 5500950.
Not the knot even if promoted: its 5310412 reset precedes target-2's USDC collateral configuration at 5310416.

ageReset.description: Listing completion for USDC: getConfiguration(USDC) went from active/decimals-only (LTV 0) to LTV 7000, liquidation threshold 7500, bonus 10500, borrowing enabled, reserve factor 1000. USDC collateral eligibility is necessary for converting the inflated lUSDC index into DOT/LDOT borrows; the later reserve-factor-only write at block 5336731 does not affect flash-premium accrual or LTV.

limitations: Intended knot (latest reset, 2315269 s = 26.8 days) but held provisional: the Acala RPC has no debug_traceTransaction, so the verifier's execution-trace (LendingPool proxy -> implementation DELEGATECALL) and creator checks are INCONCLUSIVE. The proxy creation receipt has no log emitted by the proxy, so a create-nonce proof witness is unavailable; creation is evidenced by provider nonce 1 -> 2 across blocks 5310095/5310096, CREATE(0x5aa0f1456da50828f6efb5b751f51a402bb25bbd, nonce 1) = 0x2669ff3a081dda63e7c353b6df64fa33050a9d6d, empty code at 5310095, and ProxyCreated log 0 topic1 = the proxy.
Promote to reviewed/curveEligible only if a trace-capable Acala provider reproduces the anchors or the verifier accepts log-based execution evidence.

sources.note: Reviewed anchor, root cause and earliest exercise. Chain is Acala EVM+ (eth_chainId 0x313 = 787), not Astar: the discovery lead's chain was wrong; Starlay's Acala market (starlay-finance/starlay-ui-acala src/libs/config/market.ts: LendingPool 0x2669ff3a081dda63e7c353b6df64fa33050a9d6d, provider 0x5aa0f1456da50828f6efb5b751f51a402bb25bbd) is the one reported hacked (source-13: Acala USDC pool, liquidity-index miscalculation). getReservesList = [DOT 0x...0100000000000000000002, LDOT 0x...0100000000000000000003, USDC 0x07df96d1341a7d16ba1ad431e2c847d978bc2bce]; lTokens 0x2a43c0d6.., 0xb58cb2e3.., 0x28a5afac... Acala's eth-rpc-adapter truncates receipts/eth_getLogs to 100 logs (source-1 receipt returns logIndex 0x0..0x43f sorted as strings), so full logs were read from Blockscout /api/v2/transactions/<hash>/logs with next_page_params: source-1 has 1338 logs: 200 FlashLoan (0x631042c8, each 15000 USDC, premium 13.5 USDC = 9 bps; _flashLoanPremiumTotal = 9 set in LendingPool.initialize), 260 ReserveDataUpdated, 30 Deposit, 29 Withdraw, 1 Borrow. Sequence: attacker contract 0x009965f7 (created by EOA 0xe6f6d3cd in 0x355062fb.. block 5500893) deposits 1 wei USDC, donates 15000 USDC to lUSDC, flash-loans it back 200 times; each premium is cumulated via ReserveLogic.cumulateToLiquidityIndex(lUSDC.totalSupply(), premium) (LendingPool.flashLoan line 524 of verified source), USDC liquidityIndex goes 1000001568483512182406576692 (log 1) -> 60750011740743791401151356856077208 (log 50) -> ... -> 1350000011748744083846816912048534518 (log 1309). Helper 0xc8b3bbd1 then repeats deposit 1350.000012 USDC / withdraw 2025.000015 USDC (logs 1308..1335): LToken.burn computes amount.rayDiv(index) with half-up rounding (1.5 -> 1 scaled unit), extracting 675 USDC per cycle until the attacker's USDC is recovered (lUSDC USDC balance 0 at blocks 5500950 and 5500951), then Borrow 135.0000012 DOT against the one-unit lUSDC collateral. eth_call getReserveData(USDC) at block 5500950: liquidityIndex 1000001568483512182406576692 and lUSDC scaledTotalSupply() = 1; at 5500951: 1350000011748744083846816912048534518 and 3. Earliest exercise: the index never decreases, so its near-1e27 value at 5500950 excludes any earlier inflation; eth_getLogs on lUSDC from block 0 to 5500950 returns 19 logs (Initialized at 5310412, then deposits/withdrawals by 0xfe6851e5 totalling 42.428244 USDC and two 10 USDC deposit/withdraw pairs by the attacker EOA at 5496990..5500946, none with a flash loan). The attacker's earlier contract 0xfa83a360 (5500349..5500732) never moved lUSDC funds. Source-1 is successful (status 0x1), block 5500951, index 0, timestamp 1707377899.

Reviewed loss. Blockscout api?module=account&action=tokentx for each lToken (startblock 5500900, endblock 5502600, offset 10000, pages until empty: lDOT 564 rows, lLDOT 518, lUSDC 10676) gives underlying Transfer rows; net underlying flow into each lToken was summed per transaction and the sender taken from eth_getTransactionByHash. The attacker EOA 0xe6f6d3cd38e9bf1e118c8fd1528d303d261ba4f7 sent 50 successful transactions with nonzero pool flow in blocks 5500951..5502396 (source-9): 45 calls to 45 attacker-deployed contracts (selectors 0xf8ff2906, 0x8559f08b, 0x070b4fd6; e.g. 17 x -8775.000077 DOT, 25 x -61425.444941 LDOT legs) and 5 direct LendingPool calls (5501679 deposit 1000 USDC, 5501686 borrow 100 LDOT, 5501727 repay, 5501756 borrow 10 LDOT, 5501773 withdraw 1000 USDC). Sums: DOT -1078770644033000, LDOT -14373778782257000, USDC -3876 base units. RPC cross-check: for every one of those 50 blocks, balanceOf(lToken) at block b minus block b-1 (eth_call on the DOT/LDOT/USDC ERC-20 contracts) equals the Blockscout net of all transactions in that block for all three assets (150/150 matches); only blocks 5501686, 5502225 and 5502396 hold another pool transaction, by unrelated senders. Other senders in the window net -8665.525443635 DOT and +5427.3182273313 LDOT (ordinary withdrawals, e.g. 0x6ced59a8 15000 DOT at 5502244; 0xd7079a56 is a user since block 4774892 who borrowed and repaid its own positions) and are excluded. The EOA's next transactions (5502460 approve, 5502463, a reverted call at 5502535, then blocks 5599186+) move no pool funds; the lDOT/lLDOT balances were 0.2825116515 DOT / 0.6255858231 LDOT at 5502396. realizedAt = timestamp of block 5502396 (source-5).

Reviewed artifact identity and age history. EIP-1967 slot 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc: lUSDC 0x28a5afac.. reads 0 at block 5310411 and 0x073d27dc27ed45a671182a52b1555d3bca7a1be4 at 5310412 and 5500950; LendingPool 0x2669ff3a.. reads 0 at 5310095 and 0x560ac52e66f9d50152e500be0a579d3758da68fe at 5310096 and 5500950. eth_getLogs for Upgraded(address) topic 0xbc7cd75a.. on both proxies, blocks 0..5500950: none. eth_getCode keccak: lUSDC proxy empty (0xc5d24601..) at 5310411, 0xceb7e8b2.. at 5310412 and 5500950; LendingPool proxy empty at 5310095, 0x4811778c.. at 5310096 and 5500950; LTokenRev2 impl 0x7b687e25.. and LendingPool impl 0xe6e2b40f.. at 5500950 (impls created by deployer 0x56557f80158188ada9f665c217bc6e5bc97ac738 in 0xbc8190bb.. block 5310271 and 0xff44760f.. block 5310091). lUSDC creation: source-2, sent by 0x56557f80 to configurator proxy 0x015491ae74bfb7e8712004f95e5e821217a09096 (initReserve 0xcef84c51); configurator eth_getTransactionCount 7 at 5310411 -> 10 at 5310412, CREATE nonces 7/8/9 derive lUSDC / stable-debt 0x441a7c86.. / variable-debt 0xaa1ed280..; receipt log 0 is lUSDC Initialized (0xb19e051f), log 3 configurator ReserveInitialized (0x3a0ca721). LendingPool creation: source-4 (0x5aef021f setLendingPoolImpl on provider): provider nonce 1 -> 2, CREATE(provider,1) = 0x2669ff3a.., log 0 ProxyCreated(topic1 proxy), log 1 LendingPoolUpdated(topic1 0x560ac52e..). Provider logs 0..5500950 (14) contain no later LendingPoolUpdated. Configuration: configurator logs 0..5500950 (15): ReserveInitialized DOT/LDOT/USDC at 5310408/5310410/5310412; source-3 (block 5310416, sent via helper 0xadb231b8.. while it was configuration admin) emits CollateralConfigurationChanged (0x637febbd) for USDC at log 6 (ltv 7000, threshold 7500, bonus 10500), log 7 borrowing enabled, log 8 reserve factor 1000; blocks 5336730/5336731 set reserve factor 0 for all reserves (getConfiguration(USDC) = 0x050629041d4c1b58 at 5500950, LTV unchanged). Oracle 0x93344c0d (StarlayOracle -> PriceAggregatorAdapterAcalaImpl 0xad4198af, Acala native oracle) was wired at 5310370/5310384 with no per-asset source. Age choice: the per-reserve lUSDC instance is where the empty-market defect became reachable (as in the Radiant rUSDCn record); the USDC collateral configuration four blocks later is necessary to borrow against the inflated index and is the latest reset, 2315269 s (26.8 days) before the exploit.

Verified source on Blockscout (https://blockscout.acala.network/api?module=contract&action=getsourcecode&address=<impl>), solc v0.6.12+commit.27d51765, optimizer 200 runs. LendingPool 0x560ac52e66f9d50152e500be0a579d3758da68fe: SHA-256 of SourceCode c3b2ed7b88d9fb796a89f9bd90631b78d541e3c4ccafe37356e8245ab437c6eb; flashLoan calls _reserves[asset].cumulateToLiquidityIndex(IERC20(lToken).totalSupply(), premium) with no minimum-supply guard; withdraw passes reserve.liquidityIndex to LToken.burn. LTokenRev2 0x073d27dc27ed45a671182a52b1555d3bca7a1be4: AdditionalSources contracts/protocol/tokenization/LToken.sol SHA-256 9c020d6e644c894c76edb34bc5e4d62ff8a4c8a2865824d13fc80c272bef0158; burn and mint use amount.rayDiv(index) (WadRayMath.rayDiv = (a*RAY + b/2)/b, half-up) guarded only by amountScaled != 0.

notes: The lead named Astar (chainId 592); onchain evidence places the exploited market on Acala EVM+ (chainId 787). Starlay's Astar deployment is not implicated by this campaign.

Both targets are held provisional only because the Acala RPC lacks debug_traceTransaction, which the verifier requires for execution-trace (and, for target-2, creator) checks; all other declared anchors are reproducible with eth_call/eth_getCode/eth_getStorageAt/eth_getLogs.
